text: でも　ものを　あつめたり　じまん　したい　きもちは　だれでも　ある！

structure.jp: ものを　あつめたり
じまん　したい　きもちは
structure.en: the feeling of wanting to show off

patterns.name: 〜たり
patterns.explanation: たり after a verb gives it as one example among things people do. ものを　あつめたり = 'doing things like collecting stuff'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it. じまん　したい = 'want to show off'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ものを　あつめたり　じまん　したい　きもち
patterns.explanation: The words before きもち tell you what kind of feeling it is. ものを　あつめたり　じまん　したい　きもち = 'the feeling of wanting to collect things and show them off'.
